### implementer note on this finding

Verified and resolved: this finding is a false positive. `git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat` on the PR branch shows **no ticket file in the diff at all** — the branch never touches `docs/tickets/07-resilience/0036-*.md`. Per this project's convention (ADR 0015 / implementer instructions), ticket files are committed only directly on `main` in the primary checkout, never through a feature-branch PR, so merging PR #81 cannot revert or otherwise touch the ticket's tracked `status` field. No fixup needed for this specific finding; treated as resolved-not-reproduced rather than a code/prompt defect.
